headline: Heatwave forces power plant shutdowns across Europe, putting electricity grid under strain
subhead: Six European Union countries have had to shut down some of their power plants due to lower river levels and increased water temperatures caused by heatwaves. The solar eclipse on August 12 also threatens to sharply reduce photovoltaic output.

In Russia, wherever Putin goes, gasoline prices fall
subhead: During a visit by Russian President Vladimir Putin to Krasnoyarsk, Siberia, on Monday, August 3, residents of the city were surprised to see a sudden drop in fuel prices. The event was orchestrated against the backdrop of a fuel shortage caused by Ukrainian drone attacks on the country's refineries.

headline: Thousands protest private property legislation in Argentina as clashes erupt with police
subhead: As the protest drew to a close on Thursday, scuffles broke out on Congress Square with protesters targeting police with stones and other projectiles. Security forces responded with tear gas, rubber bullets and a water cannon.

headline: Night of the Stars: Everything to know about the 2026 edition
subhead: This weekend, nearly 500 stargazing gatherings are set to take place across France. This year's theme is Sun: Our star will experience a partial eclipse over mainland France and Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, caused by the Moon, on August 12.
